Resolves #21261

All 13 Playwright `route.fetch` calls now use the native bounded `maxRetries: 2` option to tolerate transient `ECONNRESET` failures. This covers both Neural Link fixtures and all eleven spec-level fetches. Existing URL overrides, response rewriting and non-OK response handling are preserved. No custom retry loop, timeout change or HTTP-status retry policy is introduced.

Evidence: L3 (local component and E2E execution) → L3 required. The full unit run completed with one ffmpeg timeout; its complete spec passed on a focused rerun. Local E2E used Playwright Chromium through a temporary, uncommitted configuration override; the repository's Chrome configuration is unchanged.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Both fixture fetches in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` and `test/playwright/dedicatedWorkerNeuralLink.mjs` pass `{maxRetries: 2}`. |
| AC-2 | All eleven spec-level fetches pass `maxRetries: 2`. Both existing URL overrides remain intact. No inspected HTTP route handler intentionally provokes a connection reset. |
| AC-3 | All 13 calls across 12 files are covered. The sole non-retry change is a behavior-preserving shorthand/alignment cleanup required by the existing commit hook, disclosed below. |
| AC-4 | Required component specs passed locally. The E2E selection included `WorkstationFiveBeatNL`, all of `e2e/core`, `DocsMixinsNL` and `HighlightJsResources`, plus every other modified E2E spec. Full-unit results and browser qualification are disclosed below. |

## Deltas from ticket

The ticket requests a retry-only diff. The existing whole-file shorthand gate rejects `isSecureContext: isSecureContext` in the touched `InsecureHttpOrigin.spec.mjs`. This PR converts it to shorthand and corrects colon alignment in the same two object literals: four additional changed lines, with no behavior change. All commit-hook checks pass; no hooks were bypassed. Please confirm this minimal hygiene exception is acceptable.

## Test Evidence

- Full local unit run: **7,866 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed** (30-second timeout in `test/playwright/unit/test-util/flickerCensus.spec.mjs`, ffmpeg VFR adapter). Focused rerun of that entire spec with one worker: **8 passed**; the timed-out case completed in 256 ms. The full tier is not claimed green, and the timeout's cause is unconfirmed.
- Required component selection (`DockTabReorderGesture.spec.mjs` and `InsecureHttpOrigin.spec.mjs`): **3 passed**, before the behavior-preserving shorthand cleanup.
- Local E2E selection: **94 passed, 3 skipped**. This used Playwright Chromium because Google Chrome is absent locally; only the browser channel was overridden in a temporary configuration, which is not part of this PR.
- Fixture/harness unit subset: **84 passed**. Syntax and applicable whitespace, shorthand, staged block-alignment, fixed-sleep, derived-domain, secrets and ticket-archaeology checks passed. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here. Change class: restoration (`fix`), declared by the author.
